There is a beast inside of me

Raging alone and always unseen

Whispering "sweet" nothings into my ear

Even though he knows im the only one who can hear

At times I wish to silence him

But the only way is to grant his every whim

For His destructiveness knows no bounds

And he loves destruction's every sound!

He comes to me in my dreams

Showing me the sights he wants to see

Always playing his devilish melody

I think back to how things used to be

Was this beast really born from me?

Oh beast I ask when did you start?

Are you the result of my turbulent heart?

"I have always been", he replied

"In your heart is where I reside

I'm born of the tears you've tried to hide

The hurtful emotions you can't cast aside

And if you continue with them unseen

You will only serve to feed me"
